findings.title: Sixteen failure rows do not establish the complete typed failure and transaction contract
findings.trigger: Any matrix case with an incorrect semantic status but the same coarse failure classification (for example kind13 with a different numerical failure code), an incorrect attempted/rejected/nonlinear count, or an unintended write outside species/audit/chemistrySpecies.
findings.observation: Both cells species (4 entries), both full ChemistryAudit objects and every active chemistrySpecies budget entry (4) are compared. Only cell0 generic failure, unavailable classification and selected retry assertions are checked. No all-cell six-member failure status expectation, all transaction cell/face/budget snapshot, host ledger check or real begin/rollback is performed for the sixteen cases. Kinds7/15 print their row after reset/public execution, losing original failure tuples from the log.
findings.why: The supplied 16 PASS strings and accepted-path full comparisons cannot certify every failed native cell leaves all requested semantic state/ledger untouched or retains typed failure lineage.
findings.recommendation: Retain the formal original run. Add separately identified test-only observation/assertions for both pre-public status tuples, all state/budget arrays and host ledger, plus begin/validate/rollback checks. Do not alter production controls, physics, indices or admission rules. Treat any augmented fixture as support evidence, not the submitted original.
findings.calibration: No observed production failure in this review; source adapter explicitly never writes conservative rho/rhoU/rhoE on any chemistry call. Kind10 correctly returns StepLimit while retaining reaction0, and its existing unavailable classification indirectly tests that identity.

findings.title: Retry evidence omits chronological rejected-attempt details
findings.trigger: The required initial StepLimit/refinement/rollback chain, including the first failed native attempt and terminal fallback.
findings.observation: Counters and accepted dt replay are meaningful, but validate records only a StepLimit count; begin/rollback do not log dt, native flag, both-cell failure tuple or restored state. sourceDurations is collected at applySources and not printed, so it does not capture pre-transport failed chemistry attempts. Default-owner checks require some StepLimit and rollback rather than observing the first rejected call. terminalStages counts applySources(false), not every failed/pre-transport call.
findings.why: Final equality and aggregate counts do not provide the complete first/terminal call-chain trace requested by the user.
findings.recommendation: A separately retained observer should emit chronological begin/validation-failure/rollback/commit records with dt, native flag, status tuples and restored semantic state, keeping the accepted trace and exact elapsed==requestedDt comparison. Preserve host retry/terminal decision flags across successful rollback as the production owner requires.
findings.calibration: The source owner loop does attempt requestedDt first, halves retryable failures and completes terminal remaining time; no new numerical gate is proposed.
